narrative.overview: One canonical six-route light operational console. docs/product/DESIGN.md records the complete shared hierarchy, 208px shell, 14px body/12px metadata, semantic weather blue and responsive disclosure contract. Real geography and attributable facts lead; history and provenance remain subordinate.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained red selection with semantic signal colors.
Current state first, supporting information second, history and provenance subordinate.

rules.name: The Meaning Before Color Rule
rules.body: A color treatment may organize a measured fact; it must not invent an operational status.

rules.name: The Operational Priority Rule
rules.body: Give current state and actionable comparisons the strongest position and typography; use compact supporting rows, quieter history and disclosed provenance instead of equally emphasized panels.

rules.name: The Usable Fact Rule
rules.body: Omit unusable primary metrics and reflow the remaining facts. Preserve valid zero and keep absence reasons in coverage or source detail; reserve inline status for actionable load failures.

rules.name: The Flat Workspace Rule
rules.body: Organize field surfaces with hairlines and spacing instead of adding elevation to every container.

dos: **Do** preserve the established VIGIA shell and identity.
**Do** keep the map dominant and contextual controls close to it.
**Do** retain measurement units, location and date/time beside facts.
**Do** recompose dense rows at small viewports and preserve visible focus.
**Do** make current state and operational comparisons visibly stronger than history and source details.
**Do** omit unusable prime metrics, retain valid zero and provide coverage reasons in disclosure.
donts: **Don't** turn semantic color into an unsupported risk or availability claim.
**Don't** add decorative route numbers, neon, glass or generic card stacks.
**Don't** use screenshots or procedural geography as a live map.
**Don't** treat this design record as exact pixel-parity or whole-product verification.
